source.snippet: I'm amending my 2023 federal return in Sprintax. I'm a J-1 research scholar who mistakenly filed my original 2023 return on Form 1040 as a resident alien. I should have filed Form 1040-NR as a nonresident alien, so I'm amending with Form 1040-X plus a corrected 1040-NR. Sprintax asks me to select the filing status from my original return, but Head of Household is not available. (2026-11-14)

problem_statement: International students and visa holders (J-1, F-1, H-1B) on nonresident tax status routinely file incorrect US federal tax returns and face confusing, error-prone amendment workflows in existing tools like Sprintax, leading to IRS penalties and stress.
target_segment: International researchers, students, and skilled workers on US nonimmigrant visas who must file or amend nonresident alien tax returns (Form 1040-NR).
notes: Sprintax charges $50–$200/filing. The repeated confusion around amended returns for nonresidents is a known gap — existing tools handle the simple case but break on edge cases (wrong filing status, amendment workflows). A focused amendment-only or audit-protection service for nonresident filers could charge $99–$299 per case. Buyer is clear: someone who already paid for tax software and still got it wrong has demonstrated willingness to pay for a correct outcome.
